Then, pick up the old key from the antique trunk. Then, check that the wooden door is unlocked with the old key. And then, ensure that the wooden door in the bedroom is open. And then, go east. And then, put the half of a bag of chips on the stove inside the kitchen. And if you do that, you're the winner!
